pie: swésor sóh₂wl̥ tr̥sóm gʷʰr̥néwti. dʰoHnéh₂m h₂sowséye. h₁íh₂m̥ h₂sowséyoh₂. tr̥stéh₂m dʰoHnéh₂m dʰéh₁mn̥ bʰére. nu h₁íh₂m̥ wéǵʰoh₂.
english: "Sister, the sun is heating the drying-floor. Dry the grain!" "I dry it." "Carry the dried grain to the house." "I carry it."

pie: h₃rḗḱs súHnum wl̥nh₁to.
english: The king wanted a son.

pie: ph₂ter wĺ̥kʷom ḱléwsoh₂. dedwóyth₂e? dedwóyh₂e. mē tréses. ḱwṓ dʰwórm̥ h₂lékseti. nu l̥gʰdʰí swépnom-kʷe h₁áyso.
english: "Father, I hear a wolf!" "Are you afraid?" "I am afraid." "Do not tremble in fear. The dog guards the door. Lie down, and take sleep."

pie: swésor péh₂wr̥ h₂lékse. péh₂wr̥ kóslom dʰégʷʰeti h₁rudʰéh₁ti-kʷe. h₁íd nékʷti mē léh₁s. péh₂wr̥ démey priHóm dṓm-kʷe deywóybʰos priHós.
english: Sister, guard the fire! The fire burns the hazel and is red. Do not let it go in the night. The fire is dear to the house, and the house is dear to the gods.

pie: méh₂tēr swóm suHnúm h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂s usménh₁ woséyet. h₁éy wésmn̥ wésto. wésmn̥ h₁wésu? h₁íd h₁wésu. nu lówh₃trom dʰwórm̥ wéǵʰet.
english: The mother clothed her son in a garment of wool. He wore the garment. "Is the garment good?" "It is good." Then she carried the washbasin to the door.

pie: h₂éǵrom h₂érh₃yesi? h₂éǵrom h₂érh₃yoh₂. dwóh₁ táwroh₁ yugdʰí. táwroh₁ yéwgm̥. gʷṓs bʰréh₁wr̥ wédʰe. h₁íns wédʰoh₂.
english: "Are you ploughing the field?" "I am ploughing it. Yoke the two bulls." "I have yoked them. Lead the cattle to the spring." "I lead them."

pie: gʰóstey h₁idʰí deywṓs-kʷe te wédʰoyh₁ent. nékʷti mē h₁éys. sédye. nu h₂usési yéh₂esi.
english: Guest, go, and may the gods lead you! Do not go in the night. Sit down. At dawn you shall go.

pie: bʰréh₂terh₁e gʷegʷmé. sdtóm. kʷósyo suHnéwes yúH? wéy h₃rēǵés suHnéwes. h₁édtom médʰu-kʷe ph₃tóm. yúH moy priHṓs.
english: Brothers, you have come! Sit down, both of you. Whose sons are you? We are the sons of the king. Eat, and drink the mead! You are dear to me.

pie: h₂nér kʷíh₁ gʷíh₃wesi? gʷíh₃woh₂ deywṓs-kʷe moy h₁wésuh₂ h₁opéyonti. nu toy pótn̥yeh₂ey kʷíh₁ gʷíh₃weti? gʷíh₃weti. dyḗws toy h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr dʰéh₁mn̥ h₂léksoyh₁t.
english: Man, how do you live? I live, and the gods give me good things. And your wife, how does she live? She lives. May Sky, the giver of good things, protect your house!

pie: gerh₂ḗn gʷṓs ḱóymom h₂éǵet. gʷm̥sḱét nókʷts. swéh₂ pótnih₂ gʷṓs h₂mélǵt. nu gerh₂ḗn h₂éǵt. pórḱōy h₁édnom duh₃dʰí. nu h₁ésmey h₁édnom déh₃ut pórḱos-kʷe gʷr̥h₃ét. nu gerh₂ḗn sédt.
english: Crane drove the cattle home. Night was coming. His wife milked the cattle. Crane said: "Give the piglet food!" She gave it food, and the piglet ate. Then Crane sat down.

pie: ph₂ter gʷegʷómth₂e. méh₂tēr puHróm pékʷeti. wódr̥ bʰr̥h₁wéns bʰéroh₂ swésōr-kʷe moy gʷṓs h₂mélǵti. sddʰí. dedórḱh₂e te ḱḗr-kʷe moy méwdt.
english: Father, you have come back! Mother is cooking the grain. I carry water from the spring, and my sister milks the cattle. Sit down. I see you, and my heart rejoiced.

pie: owis, yāi wl̥nā ne eest, dedorḱe eḱwons, tom woǵʰom gʷr̥um weǵʰontm̥, tom bʰorom meǵm̥, tom ǵʰm̥onm̥ ōku bʰerontm̥.
english: A sheep that had no wool saw horses, one of them pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, and one carrying a man quickly.

pie: ḱwónm̥ moy toy dh₃dʰí. ḱwónm̥ toy ne dédeh₃mi. h₁éy moy h₂éǵmn̥ h₂lékseti. nu toy dwóyh₁ h₂ówih₁ dédeh₃mi. ḱwónm̥ ne h₁opéyoh₂. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m misdʰóm h₁áyso.
english: "Give me your dog." "I do not give you the dog. It guards my flock." "I give you two sheep." "I do not give the dog. Take wool as a reward."

pie: kʷséps gʷémt. sóh₂wl̥ légʰt. l̥gʰdʰí swépnom-kʷe h₁áyso. ph₂tḗr toy bʰéwdʰeti. wĺ̥kʷos dʰéh₁mn̥ mē h₁r̥yéh₁t. nu sóh₂wl̥ widḗsi.
english: The night has come. The sun has lain down. Lie down, and take sleep. Your father is awake. May no wolf arrive at the house! Then you shall see the sun.

pie: méh₂tēr h₁édnom h₂réydʰeti. ph₂tḗr sédyeti. kʷíd h₁édmes? puHróm wósh₂r̥-kʷe h₁édmes. nu gʷr̥h₃ónti.
english: The mother prepares the food. The father sits down. "What do we eat?" "We eat grain and garlic." Then they eat.

pie: kʷíd h₁énod? h₁énos wĺ̥kʷos. h₂éǵrom mē h₁éys. ne h₁éymi. nu swésor démbʰis yéh₂omes poh₂imnéy-kʷe wérh₁omes.
english: "What is that yonder?" "That yonder is a wolf." "Do not go to the field!" "I do not go. Let us go home, sister, and tell the shepherd."

pie: gʰóstey túH priHós. nu pékʷtōr h₁édnom h₂réydʰet. puHróm wósh₂r̥-kʷe h₁éddʰi pl̥h₁dʰí-kʷe.
english: Guest, you are dear! The cook prepared the food. Eat the grain and the garlic, and be full!

pie: kʷís gʰóstey túH? h₁eǵóh₂ h₂ŕ̥tḱosyo suHnús h₁nómn̥-kʷe moy pérkʷus. pérkʷew kú h₁yénti? h₃rēǵés dṓm yéh₂mi. gʷh₂dʰí.
english: "Who are you, stranger?" "I am the son of Bear, and my name is Oak." "Where are you going, Oak?" "I am going to the house of the king." "Go!"

pie: dʰéh₁mn̥ moy gʷémesi? gʷémoh₂. nu pékʷtōr h₁édnom h₂réydʰeti pórḱom-kʷe dédeh₃mi. bʰérmn̥ mē bʰéres. túH nos gʰóstis.
english: "Will you come to my house?" "I will come." "The cook prepares the food, and I give the piglet." "Do not bring a gift. You are our guest."

pie: méh₂ter tr̥syóh₂. wódr̥ ph₃dʰí. wódr̥ ne píph₃oh₂. nu moy médʰu dh₃dʰí. médʰu h₂nr̥bʰós h₁ésti. ph₃dʰí h₂uksdʰí-kʷe.
english: "Mother, I am thirsty." "Drink the water." "I do not drink water. Give me mead!" "Mead is for men. Drink, and grow big."

pie: kʷís dyḗws? dyḗws deywṓm wiHrṓm-kʷe ph₂tḗr. nu kʷís dʰéǵʰōm? dʰéǵʰōm méh₂tēr. deywṓs m̥rént? wiHrṓs m̥rént. deywṓs ne m̥rént.
english: "Who is Dyēus?" "Dyēus is the father of the gods and of men." "And who is Earth?" "Earth is the mother." "Do the gods die?" "Men die; the gods do not die."

pie: h₂éwsōs h₂wést. bʰéwdʰesi? nu bʰéwdʰoh₂. h₁eǵʰ gʷm̥dʰí sóh₂wl̥-kʷe widé.
english: Dawn has become bright. Are you awake? Yes, I am awake. Come out, and see the sun!

pie: dwóh₁ h₁éḱwoh₁ tréyes táwrōs septḿ̥ h₂óweyes pórḱos-kʷe tworḱósyo démi h₁ési. ḱm̥tóm h₂óweyes gr̥h₂nés h₂éǵroy h₁sénti. nu tworḱós wéwket. h₂éǵmn̥ toy méǵh₂. pérkʷunos h₁íd ph₂syéh₁t.
english: In the house of Boar there are two horses, three bulls, seven sheep, and a piglet. In the field of Crane are a hundred sheep. Boar said: "Your flock is big. May Perkʷunos guard it."

pie: ḱóymom h₂eh₂nóḱth₂e. widé. nu nos suHnús gʷegʷóme. h₁ím dedórḱh₂e ḱḗr-kʷe moy méwdt. sddʰí gʷr̥h₃é-kʷe.
english: You have reached home! See: our son has come. I see him, and my heart rejoiced. Sit down, and eat.

pie: kʷís gʰóstey túH? h₁eǵóh₂ poh₂imḗn h₁nómn̥-kʷe moy wĺ̥kʷos. wĺ̥kʷe nos dṓm gʷm̥dʰí. nu gʰóstis h₁sdʰí.
english: Who are you, stranger? I am a shepherd, and my name is Wolf. Come, Wolf, to our house! Then be our guest.

pie: pékʷtōr tworḱós pórḱom pékʷet. nu gʰóstipotis gʰostéyey wéwket. gʰóstey pórḱom gʷr̥h₃é médʰuh₂-kʷe ph₃dʰí. nu gʰóstis gʷr̥h₃ét píph₃et-kʷe. gʰóstipoteys ḱḗr méwdt.
english: Boar the cook cooked the piglet. The lord said to the guest: "Guest, eat the piglet, and drink the mead!" The guest ate and drank. The lord's heart rejoiced.

pie: h₂éwsōs lówksneh₂-kʷe bʰréh₁wr̥ gʷh₂tā́m. nu h₂éwsōs h₂éǵt. lówksna bʰr̥h₁wéns wódr̥ ph₃dʰí. píph₃oh₂. nu nos méh₂tēr wódr̥ h₂isḱéti. nu h₁íd ḱóymom wéǵʰetām.
english: Dawn and Moon went to the spring. Dawn said: "Moon, drink the water of the spring!" "I drink." "Our mother seeks water." Then they carried it home.

pie: h₂ówis tu h₁eḱwoibʰ(y)os weukʷét, "ḱḗr Hegʰnutór moi h₁éḱwons Héǵontm̥ Hnérm̥ widn̥tbʰ(y)os."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."
